title: ZenXveda: Reimagined Shaders
author: ZenXveda Official
description: 水面表現、雲、自然な色味を調整するVanilla+系シェーダー。
fullDescription: 📦 ZenXveda Reimagined Shaders — v2.0.2 Release Welcome to v2.0.2 of ZenXveda Reimagined Shaders for Minecraft Bedrock Edition! This maintenance release synchronizes our CurseForge release channel with the latest Minecraft Bedrock updates, ensuring smooth client-side auto-updates, rock-solid resource pack validation, and full stability for the Deferred Technical Preview pipeline. 🔄 What's Changed in v2.0.2 📦 Pack Manifest Version Alignment Incremented Internal Version : Updated manifest.json header and modules to v2.0.2 ( [2, 0, 2] ) for instant CurseForge client-side update detection and automatic resource reloading. 🌐 CurseForge Distribution Synchronization Clean Archive Build : Compiled as ZenXveda_Reimagined_Shaders_v2.0.2.mcpack . Cross-Platform POSIX Standard : Normalized using strict forward slashes ( / ) to ensure zero-warning imports across Windows 10/11 PC, Android (Vulkan/GLES), iOS, and Consoles. ✨ Core Visuals & Stability Intact Invisible Vanilla Clouds : Calibrated full-alpha cloud mask ( textures/environment/clouds.png ) blocks vanilla cloud block generation, keeping the sky 100% dedicated to deferred volumetric atmospheric scattering. Fluid PBR & Dynamic Caustics : Smooth water normal maps and absorption curves ( roughness: 10 , metalness: 32 ) with zero z-fighting or texture conflicts. Engine Compatibility : Verified for Minecraft Bedrock 1.20+ through 26.60+ . 📥 Installation Instructions Download ZenXveda_Reimagined_Shaders_v2.0.2.mcpack and open it to import into Minecraft Bedrock Edition. In World Settings or Global Resources , activate ZenXveda Reimagined Shaders at the top. (For Full PBR Visuals) : Go to Settings → Video and select Deferred Technical Preview under Graphics Mode!

The v1.5.0 package was checked against v1.4.50: only the manifest changed. No new in-game test was run for this metadata update.

Biomes: all 93, including the End outer islands. Vanilla sounds, Nether particles and music, and special grass colours are back. Water colours are natural again. Skies and colour: 39 skies, each tinted to its biome's ray colour; a big soft sun glow and coloured sunsets; colour grading and lighting per group (warm, green, cold, pale, caves, Nether, End). PBR and light: global PBR (light through leaves), soft shadows and coloured block light. Living-world script: dust glowing in the sun rays; sun sparkles on water; birds and fireflies; falling leaves and cherry petals; rainbows and bubbles. fullDescription: Chests no longer forced into the christmas set Every non-copper chest now uses normal chest art instead of christmas art: single, double, trapped, double trapped, ender, and the chest / trapped chest / ender chest block faces. The dedicated holiday textures ( christmas.png , christmas_double.png ) also ship the normal art, so the game's December chest swap no longer flips chests back to presents for a few days a year. New subpack: Christmas Forever The old christmas chest art now lives in its own subpack, so it can be turned back on from the pack's subpack menu. Two entries ship: Normal Chests (default) and Christmas Forever . A single subpack entry would always be applied, which is why the normal one exists as an explicit choice rather than relying on "no subpack selected". Normal chest textures from Bare Bones 26.51 were saturated per texture to the mean saturation this pack's chest art already had at that path, so the restored chests sit in the same palette as the rest of the pack. No resampling, alpha preserved byte for byte, only saturation moves — hue and value are untouched. Five chest block faces have no Bare Bones sprite, so the matching face of the same material is used rather than inventing new pixels ( chest_bottom from chest_top , trapped side/top/bottom from the chest faces, ender bottom from the ender top). Fixes Pack name and manifest version are in sync again (the name still said 1.2.1 while the version was already 1.2.2). Chest block faces no longer mix festive front/side/top art with plain bottoms. General bug fixes and polish.

fullDescription: # OS CLIENT V1.1 Use **OS CLIENT V1.1** on its own, or add any of the three extensions in any mix. Extensions and info: https://oskullo-yt.github.io/OS-CLIENT/ ## Packs - **OS CLIENT V1.1**: the main client (HUD, keystrokes, hitbox, PvP utility, damage numbers and more). - **OS MINI-MAP V1.1**: chunk map, waypoints and waypoint beam, with all their settings. - **OS COSMETICS V1.1**: capes, wings, kitten, katana, halo, aura, bandana and particle trails, with all their settings. - **OS CHUNK BORDERS V1.1**: chunk border lines in 3rd person, with the colour setting. ## Install Put the extensions **above** OS CLIENT V1.1 in Global Resources. No loader is needed. Any mix works. ## New - Minimap, cosmetics and chunk borders are now optional packs. Their models, animations, render controllers and particles are no longer in the main pack. - Animated "get ... at" extensions link on the main menu. - New update card and changelog page on the start screen, with a full feature list. - PvP Utility and Elytra Indicator are now documented in the in-game feature list. - Pack description now points to the settings and the extensions site. ## Changed - Hitbox, damage indicator and PvP Utility only work on players within 15 blocks. - Hitbox is drawn on players only (no mob hitboxes). - Less work per player: hitbox colour and PvP Utility refresh less often. - Removed the big "OS CLIENT" text from the pack info panel. - Cleaner, smaller pack files and corrected manifests. ## Fixed - Armor error. - Removed the loading screen override. - Invalid JSON in the third-person nametag model. - Corrected the in-game hitbox description. ## Known issues - HUD elements shift while riding horses or boats. - The minimap does not remember your last waypoint after you rejoin a world. - The minimap can still add lag on low-end devices when it is turned on. fullDescription: 🎉 G-Flow Xray 1.3.1: Preset Combos! Some players only want one ore, and some don't want everything lit up at once. Now there's something in between. ✨ What's new ⛏️ Starter Ores Highlights Coal, Iron and Copper together. Move the slider to Starter Ores or Rare Ores . Jump into your world and start mining. The new presets sit on the slider between the single ores and All Ores . 📌 Good to know Normal and deepslate versions of every ore in a preset are highlighted, so you don't miss anything at any depth. The single-ore options, the Nether ores and All Ores are all still there. It's still best with Vibrant Visuals , Smooth Lighting off, Brightness 100% and a higher Render Distance. 💬 Got an idea for another combo? Let me know which ores you'd like grouped together, and it might show up in a future update.

fullDescription: ZenXveda: Unbound Shaders — v1.0.0 Initial Release The Premier Cinematic PBR Shader Experience for Minecraft Bedrock Edition (1.20+ / 26.60+) Welcome to the official v1.0.0 Initial Release of ZenXveda: Unbound Shaders . Release Highlights Photorealistic HD Round Sun Full Round Geometry : Replaced the vanilla pixelated square sun with a smooth, high-definition celestial solar sphere. Volumetric Skybox & Horizon Overhaul Volumetric Daytime Clouds : Realistic, multi-layered Unbound cloudscapes integrated with Bedrock's atmospheric light scattering. Seamless Horizon Transition : Applied smoothstep vertical feathering across the equatorial cubemap faces, eliminating harsh horizon seams and curved void bowl artifacts. Pure Dark Night Skies : Re-tuned ambient cubemap lighting curves to transition naturally from warm sunset twilight into a deep, star-filled night sky. Vanilla Cloud Occlusion : Fully occluded vanilla 2D block clouds to prevent visual clipping through custom volumetric clouds. Cinematic PBR Materials & Glowing Ores Sub-Surface Bioluminescent Ores : High-definition PBR emissive maps for Diamond, Gold, Iron, Redstone, Emerald, Lapis, Copper, and Nether Quartz ores. Crystal Dynamic Waters : Refractive water surfaces featuring realistic normal maps, sun/moon specular highlights, and gentle wave motion. Atmospheric Star Field : Immersive twinkling stars powered by custom vertex-lit star materials. Engine Optimization & Stability CurseForge & Bedrock 1.20+ Ready : Validated against strict Bedrock schema specifications ( min_engine_version: [1, 20, 0] ). 100% Clean Content Log : Fixed missing particle hooks, resolved particle schema definitions, and purged invalid material bindings. Zero Bloatware : Stripped redundant legacy files, duplicate update assets, and unused texture directories, achieving an ultra-compact package size (~26.9 MB). Strict JSON Compliance : All 85 internal JSON files verified with zero syntax errors, comments, or trailing commas. Compatibility & System Requirements Feature Specification Minecraft Edition Minecraft Bedrock Edition (Windows 10/11, Android, iOS, Xbox, PlayStation) Engine Version 1.20.0 through 26.60+ (Fully forward-compatible) Render Pipelines Standard Render Dragon & Deferred Technical Preview (Vibrant Visuals) Achievements 100% Safe (Does not disable Xbox / PSN achievements) Quick Installation Guide Download ZenXveda_Unbound_Shaders_v1.0.0.mcpack . Double-click or tap the file to automatically import it into Minecraft. In Minecraft, navigate to Settings > Global Resources > My Packs . Select ZenXveda: Unbound Shaders and click Activate . Set your in-game Graphics Mode to Deferred Technical Preview (if supported by your device) or standard Fancy Graphics for maximum performance.

fullDescription: Renamed the pack to Long Hand Removed the "Long Hand Only" subpack. Two options remain: Animated Long Hand and All Features. title: Glass Shields: Yours & Others
description: Minecraft Bedrock向けリソースパック。詳細・対応バージョンは配布元ページで確認してください。
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Turns shields into glass, so a raised shield no longer hides what is in front of you. Two packs in one download Opening the .mcaddon installs two packs. Glass Shield: Yours. The main pack. Changes your own shield in first person. Glass Shield: Others. Changes the shields you see other players and mobs holding. Turning it on adds Yours automatically. How to use Only your shield: turn on Yours. Both: turn on Others too, and pick a look in each one's settings. They can look different, for example clear glass for yours and red stained glass for others. Only other players' shields: turn on both and set Yours to Normal shield. 19 choices Normal shield (no glass). This one is at the top of the list. Glass: frame only, half see-through, faint tint. Stained glass: white, light blue, blue, purple, red, yellow, green, black. Art: diamond mosaic, red cross, blue stripes, creeper, rainbow, sky fade. Glass (recommended). This is the last one in the list, so it is selected automatically. Notes Resource pack only. No behaviour pack, no scripts, no commands. Achievements are unaffected. This only changes how shields look. Blocking, durability and hit detection are exactly the same as vanilla. Banner patterns are not shown on the shield while this pack is active. The game draws them with a solid material, so they cannot show through glass. Clear Shield (my other pack) changes the same shield files. If both are on, the one higher in the list wins. Nothing breaks, just use the one you like. Important: Minecraft updates can change how shields are drawn. If the shield looks wrong after an update, check for a new version of this pack. The pack names and descriptions are translated into all 29 languages Minecraft offers. All looks work on every device, including phones and tablets. Installation Download the .mcaddon and open it. Both packs are installed at once. Enable Yours (and Others if you want) under Global Resources in settings, then pick a look from the dropdown. If the .mcaddon does not open on your device, download the two .mcpack files from Additional Files instead. Author: kentotukun 日本語 盾をガラスにして、構えても前が見えるようにします。 1回のダウンロードで2つ入ります .mcaddon を開くと、2つのパックが入ります。 ガラスの盾：自分の盾。メインのパックです。一人称で見た自分の盾を変えます。 ガラスの盾：相手の盾。他のプレイヤーやモブが持っている盾を変えます。有効にすると「自分の盾」も自動で入ります。 使い方 自分の盾だけ：「自分の盾」を有効にします。 両方：「相手の盾」も有効にして、それぞれの設定（歯車）で見た目を選びます。自分は透明なガラス、相手は赤い色ガラス、のように別々にできます。 相手の盾だけ：両方を有効にして、「自分の盾」を「普通の盾」にします。 全19種類 普通の盾（ガラスにしない）。リストの一番上です。 ガラス：枠だけ、半透明、うっすら色付き。 色ガラス：白、水色、青、紫、赤、黄、緑、黒。 模様：ひし形モザイク、赤い十字、青の斜めしま、クリーパー、虹、空のグラデーション。 ガラス（おすすめ）。リストの一番下なので、最初からこれが選ばれています。 注意 リソースパックだけです。ビヘイビアーパック・スクリプト・コマンドは入っていません。実績は無効になりません。 変わるのは見た目だけです。防御・耐久値・当たり判定はバニラと同じです。 このパックを入れている間、盾の旗の模様は表示されません。ゲームが模様を不透明な材質で描くので、ガラスの中に透かせないためです。 透ける盾（Clear Shield、私の別のパック）は同じ盾のファイルを変えます。両方を有効にすると、リストで上にある方が使われます。壊れることはないので、好きな方を使ってください。 重要：Minecraft のアップデートで盾の描き方が変わると、表示がおかしくなることがあります。そのときは、新しい版が出ていないか確認してください。 パック名と説明は、Minecraft で選べる全29言語に翻訳しています。スマホやタブレットを含むどの端末でも、すべての見た目が使えます。 入れ方 .mcaddon をダウンロードして開きます。2つのパックが一度に入ります。設定の「グローバルリソース」で「自分の盾」（必要なら「相手の盾」も）を有効にして、ドロップダウンで見た目を選びます。 .mcaddon が開けない端末では、「追加ファイル」から .mcpack を2つダウンロードしてください。 作者：kentotukun

fullDescription: # oSkullo's Durability Armor HUD — v2.0.0 The HUD has been rebuilt on the new OS ArmorHUD engine. You get more display options and a simpler settings menu. ## Added - Layout dropdown: Vertical or Horizontal, each with or without a background. - Durability Style dropdown: Percent, Durability Bar, real durability (421/422) on the Left or Right side of the icon, or Off. - Number Color: choose colored numbers (by durability) or plain white. - Show Empty Slots: keep the hotbar cell visible when no armor is worn in that slot. - Offhand slot: shows while holding a totem or shield (Show Offhand toggle). - Low Durability Warning: a red ! on the armor icon, a top-center card, both, or off. - Show Armor HUD master toggle to switch the whole HUD on or off. ## Changed - Position is now two sliders: Position X (-400 to 400) and Position Y (-150 to 150). - The HUD now has its own rendering, so it layers more cleanly on screen. - The Armor HUD code now follows the `os:` naming throughout. - Minimum game version is now 1.21.130. ## Removed - The old per-part sliders: Group X/Y, Background X/Y/Size, Icon Size, Bar X/Y/Size and Number X/Y/Size. - The old Arrangement slider and the show/hide toggles for background, bar and numbers. The Layout and Durability Style dropdowns replace them. ## Notes - Your old settings won't carry over. Everything resets to the new defaults the first time you load the pack. - The HUD is still drawn in the world, so Minecraft draws the first-person hand and held item over it. Use Position X/Y to move the HUD clear of your hand.

fullDescription: Astrelle Shader — v1.0 An original, medium-vibrant shader for Minecraft Bedrock 1.21+, built to make vanilla worlds feel warmer and more alive without going overboard. Features: 🌅 Warm, cinematic sun and moon lighting with smooth sunrise/sunset color transitions (sun illuminance capped for balanced exposure, no blown-out highlights) 🎨 Moderate ACES-based color grading — richer saturation and contrast in highlights and midtones, tuned warm color temperature ☁️ Soft volumetric atmospherics with layered sky scattering for depth at dawn and dusk 💧 Realistic water with full wave simulation, dynamic caustics, physically-based reflection (fresnel + sun/moon specular highlights) and refraction (accurate index of refraction, underwater distortion and blur) 🐊 Biome-aware water and fog: murky green, low-visibility swamps; deep saturated blue oceans and rivers with stronger waves 🏜️ Warmer desert & mesa lighting for that golden, sun-baked feel ✨ Refined PBR fallback values for subtly improved surface reflectivity across blocks, actors, particles, and items 🌑 Soft shadows enabled Design philosophy: Astrelle aims for "beautiful, not blinding" — enhancements are deliberately restrained so the shader stays performant and doesn't wash out builds with excessive bloom or oversaturation. Compatible with Minecraft Bedrock 1.21+. Fully original work — no copied assets, textures, or third-party licensed content. Version 1.0 — initial release. Created by Dark_PixelForge

fullDescription: ⚡ Quick Actions Move and craft faster on Minecraft Bedrock, with no shift-clicking. Quick Actions adds a Quick Move toggle and a Fast Craft button to your UI. It's built to work cleanly with popular container add-ons. ✨ Features • Quick Move toggle: switch it on, then tap any item slot to send the whole stack to the other inventory. The toggle shows ON or OFF so you always know its state. • Fast Craft button (⚡): sits next to the crafting output in the crafting table, inventory crafting and stonecutter. One tap crafts the result and sends it to your inventory. • Double-tap move: double-tap a slot to move its stack (Standard subpack). • Smart toggle placement: the toggle appears only where you actually move items. Machine screens like furnaces, drives and generators stay clean. 📦 Where the toggle appears • Vanilla chests, double chests, trapped chests, ender chests, barrels and shulker boxes • Project Chest • Barrel Expansion • Better Containers (chests, double chests, barrels, shulkers) • UtilityCraft Digital Storage: Storage Terminal and Crafting Terminal ⚙️ Subpacks Choose one in the pack settings: • Standard (recommended): toggle + fast craft + double-tap move • Quick Move toggle only • Fast Craft only • Always Quick Move: every container, no toggle 📥 Installation Download the .mcpack and open it with Minecraft. Activate it in your world's Resource Packs. Place Quick Actions above Project Chest, Barrel Expansion, Better Containers and UtilityCraft Digital Storage in the pack list. This is required for compatibility. ❓ FAQ The toggle isn't showing on a container. Make sure Quick Actions is above the other packs. If it's still missing, report the container's name in the comments. Does it work on mobile? Yes, it was built and tested for the mobile UI. 🐞 Feedback Found a container that should have the toggle, or a UI problem? Leave a comment with a screenshot.

title: Xray Ultimate
description: X-ray for Bedrock. The first and original pack with terrain outlines, so you can see where you walk! Achievements stay on.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: First ever Xray texturepack with outlines! for Minecraft Bedrock From the creator of Xray Ultimate for Java , downloaded over 80 million times ✅ Achievements stay ON 💎 22 modes 🔦 Cave lines ✨ Glowing ores 📱 PC, phone and tablet See ores, caves and structures straight through the ground . Stone, deepslate, dirt, netherrack, sand, gravel, wood and the other blocks you dig through turn invisible, and everything worth finding stays. 💎 Why players use it Every ore at once. Diamonds, ancient debris and every other ore stay visible, along with spawners, chests and vaults. 🔦 Cave lines. Hold a pickaxe, shovel, axe, hoe or sword and glowing blue lines trace the hidden rock around you, so you can read the cave through solid ground. ⚙️ Runs on any device. Pick a level from Ultra to Potato to match your device. New in 1.6: the cave lines check every block around you in a fixed order, so there are no gaps, and the default level is lighter than before. 22 modes : three looks for the cave lines and Stone x-ray, each at five levels, plus X-ray only and Structures only, switched with the gear icon on the pack. Achievements stay on. It's a normal resource pack, not an add-on. ✨ Glowing ores. With Vibrant Visuals or Ray Tracing on, the colored parts of every ore glow in the dark. Ores keep their normal look , so you know right away what you're looking at. Stone x-ray. Only the rock disappears. Dirt, grass, sand, gravel and trees stay, so you can still find your way. Structures only. The ores are hidden too, so spawners, trial spawners, vaults, chests and other structure blocks stand out. 🛡️ Safety built in. Lava, water and bedrock always stay visible, silverfish blocks get a red square, and gravel shows as a striped stick so you can see what might fall on you. 📱 Works on Windows, Android, iPhone, iPad and Chromebook. 🔦 Cave lines Hold a pickaxe, shovel, axe, hoe or sword and thin glowing lines show the invisible rock around you, up to 14 blocks ahead depending on the level. They skip ores, so ores still stand out on their own. The lines reach further in the direction you look and follow your view up and down, so you see ahead down a tunnel or shaft. Three looks, each at five levels: Block outlines (the default): A clean grid around every hidden block. Dots : A single dot on each face, lighter to draw than block outlines. Terrain outline : Highlights terrain edges. The lightest look. The lines only show in first person, with the tool in your main hand, and with Hide Hand turned off in the settings. ⚙️ Pick your level Every look comes in five levels. Higher levels reach further and cost more: Ultra : 14 blocks ahead. Gaming PCs, Xbox Series X, PS5, the newest iPads and flagship phones. High (the default): 13 blocks ahead. Most devices. Medium : 11 blocks ahead. Xbox One, PS4, mid-range phones, older iPads. Low : 9 blocks ahead. Budget phones, older tablets, the original Switch. Potato : 7 blocks ahead. The oldest and weakest devices. 🎛️ The 22 modes Block outlines, Terrain outline and Dots set the look of the cave lines, and Ultra to Potato how far they reach. Stone x-ray uses block outlines but only hides stone, deepslate, netherrack and other rock. Left to right on the slider: Block outlines: Ultra Block outlines: High (the default) Block outlines: Medium Block outlines: Low Block outlines: Potato X-ray only : no cave lines at all Terrain outline: Ultra Terrain outline: High Terrain outline: Medium Terrain outline: Low Terrain outline: Potato Dots: Ultra Dots: High Dots: Medium Dots: Low Dots: Potato Stone x-ray: Ultra Stone x-ray: High Stone x-ray: Medium Stone x-ray: Low Stone x-ray: Potato Structures only : the ores are hidden, so chests, trial spawners, vaults, end portal frames, suspicious sand and more stand out 📥 How to install Download the .mcpack file and open it. Minecraft imports it by itself. Go to Settings > Global Resources , select Xray Ultimate under My Packs and press Activate . Select the pack again, press the gear icon and move the slider to pick a mode. Block outlines: High is picked by default. ⚠️ Change modes from the main menu. Bedrock locks the slider while you're in a world. ⚙️ Best settings 🔦 For the cave lines , hold a pickaxe, shovel, axe, hoe or sword in first person, and keep Hide Hand off. ⚙️ If the game stutters, pick a lower level or Terrain outline , the lightest look. ✨ Turn on Vibrant Visuals if your device can handle it. The ores light up in the dark, so you can spot them from far away. 🧪 With normal graphics, use a Night Vision potion in deep caves. Resource packs can't change light levels. ☀️ Keep Brightness at 100%. 💡 If ores still look dark, turn off Smooth Lighting in the video settings. ❓ FAQ Does it turn off achievements? No. It's a resource pack, and resource packs don't affect achievements. How do I turn on the cave lines? Hold a pickaxe, shovel, axe, hoe or sword in first person, with Hide Hand off. The lines show on the hidden rock around you. Pick the look and level with the slider. The cave lines run a bit heavy on my phone. Pick a lower level, like Low or Potato, or switch to Terrain outline, the lightest look. X-ray only turns the lines off completely. Where did the "Only diamonds" modes go? Version 1.6 replaced the ore filters with looks and levels for the cave lines. Every mode shows all ores, and Structures only hides them when you are hunting for structures. Can I use it on servers and Realms? It loads anywhere your global resource packs load. Most servers ban x-ray and can ban you for using it, so only use it where it's allowed: your own worlds, your Realm and anarchy servers. Why can't I change modes inside my world? Bedrock locks the mode slider while a world is open. Go back to the main menu, change the mode and join again. Why don't the ores glow for me? The glow only shows with Vibrant Visuals or Ray Tracing turned on in the video settings. With normal graphics the ores keep their normal look. Why are some blocks still visible? Bedrock only lets resource packs hide blocks that existed in version 1.19 or earlier. Some blocks that got their own ID later, like granite, diorite and andesite, can stay visible. Why do some blocks look empty in my inventory? The pack hides those blocks everywhere, including your inventory and hotbar. Untick the pack in Global Resources when you want to build, or use Stone x-ray, which keeps dirt, sand, wood and building blocks visible. What are the red squares and striped sticks? Red squares are silverfish blocks, so you don't break into a swarm. Striped sticks are gravel, which can fall on you when you dig under it. ☕ Playing Java? Get Xray Ultimate for Java 💬 Found a block that still shows up, or have a question? fullDescription: Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ Welcome to a fresh way of experiencing Minecraft! Minecraft's world is full of incredible places, from wide-open plains and peaceful forests to deep caves and distant landscapes. But sometimes, it's the little details that make exploring those places even more enjoyable. That's where Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ comes in! This pack reimagines Minecraft's vanilla fog to give the world a more lively, immersive atmosphere without losing the familiar feeling that makes Minecraft special. Each environment gets its own atmospheric touch, helping landscapes feel more distinctive and giving your adventures a fresh visual experience. Whether you're wandering through a quiet forest, crossing an open desert, exploring underground caves, or building somewhere you can call home, the atmosphere becomes part of the experience. With 61 reimagined biomes, each bringing its own atmospheric touch, Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ gives Minecraft's familiar landscapes a fresh identity. Two ways to experience the world Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ comes with two subpacks, allowing you to choose how much fog you want in your world. Less Foggy — Clearer Views Prefer seeing more of the world around you? This option reduces fog density, giving you a clearer view of distant landscapes and surroundings while keeping the reimagined atmosphere. Perfect for players who enjoy exploring, building, and appreciating the details of their surroundings without too much fog getting in the way. More Foggy — Cozy and Immersive Want a stronger atmospheric experience? More Foggy increases the fog to create a more noticeable sense of depth and distance. Enjoy a cozier atmosphere, more distinctive landscapes, and a world that feels a little more mysterious. It's a great choice for players who love immersive environments and atmospheric exploration. Made for the Vanilla Experience The goal isn't to turn Minecraft into a completely different game. It's to take something already familiar and give it a fresh identity. - Reimagined vanilla fog. - Carefully adjusted atmospheric colors. - Two different fog experiences to choose from. - Designed to preserve Minecraft's familiar visual identity. - Suitable for exploration, building, survival, and everyday gameplay. Rediscover Your World Sometimes, a small change can make a familiar world feel like somewhere new. Take a walk through your favorite biome, watch the horizon, explore somewhere you've never been, or simply enjoy the atmosphere around your builds. Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ — Rediscover the atmosphere of Minecraft.

title: Partical Disabler | FPS Boost | Optimizer
description: Particles Disabler is a Minecraft Bedrock performance and PvP utility pack that removes distracting particles, reduces visual clutter, and offers All Off, PvP, and Mining modes for cleaner combat and smoother gameplay on MCPE.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Particles Disabler | PvP & FPS Optimization Cleaner Combat, Less Visual Clutter Particles Disabler is a Minecraft Bedrock utility and performance pack designed to remove unnecessary particles that can block your view, clutter the screen, and add extra visual processing during gameplay. It is especially useful for PvP, low-end devices, heavy farms, mob grinders, mining, Nether exploration, and effect-heavy situations where large amounts of particles can become distracting or contribute to performance problems. Instead of forcing one configuration on every player, the pack includes three selectable modes , allowing you to choose between maximum particle removal, combat-focused cleanup, or mining-oriented optimization. Reduce distracting effects, keep important gameplay easier to see, and choose the particle configuration that fits the way you play. Remove Screen-Blocking Particles One of the main purposes of Particles Disabler is improving visibility during combat. Minecraft can produce several effects directly around the player during fights, making opponents harder to track at critical moments. This pack targets many of those distracting effects. Totem of Undying Particles Removes the large visual particles that appear when a Totem activates, helping keep your opponent visible immediately after a totem pop. Potion Swirls Removes the swirling potion particles that normally surround players with active effects. TNT & Explosion Particles Reduces the smoke, flashes, and visual clutter produced by explosions. Eating Particles Removes the particles that appear while eating food, Golden Apples, and other consumables. Critical Hit & Combat Particles Reduces distracting particles generated during fights for a cleaner PvP view. Three Performance Modes Particles Disabler includes three configurable modes that can be selected through the resource pack settings / Gear icon. All Off Mode Designed for maximum particle reduction. This mode disables the targeted particle effects as aggressively as possible and is intended for players who prioritize performance and visibility over decorative effects. Best suited for: Low-end devices Heavy farms Mob grinders Large multiplayer areas Performance-focused Minecraft setups PvP Mode Designed specifically for competitive and combat-focused gameplay. PvP Mode removes the particles most likely to interfere with player visibility during fights while keeping the experience less aggressive than the full All Off configuration. Targets effects such as: Totem particles Potion swirls TNT and explosion effects Eating particles Combat-related visual clutter This helps create a cleaner battlefield during Crystal PvP, Sword PvP, SMP fights, competitive servers, and other combat situations . Mining Mode Mining Mode focuses on creating a cleaner experience inside caves and underground areas. It is designed for players who want reduced particle clutter while mining, exploring caves, working around lava, or moving through particle-heavy underground environments. Performance-Focused Particle Reduction Particles may look small individually, but many of them can appear simultaneously around mob farms, explosions, fire, lava, Redstone builds, grinders, PvP fights, and crowded servers . Reducing unnecessary particle effects can decrease visual clutter and may reduce rendering workload, particularly on devices that already struggle in demanding Minecraft environments. This makes the pack useful for both mobile players and PC users who prefer a lighter visual setup. Actual FPS improvements depend on device hardware, Minecraft version, graphics settings, world complexity, render distance, server conditions, and other active resource packs. Built for PvP Visibility Particles Disabler is not only a performance pack. Its combat-focused options are also designed around visual clarity . Totem pops, potion effects, explosions, eating animations, and combat particles can temporarily cover important parts of the screen. Removing selected effects can make it easier to track nearby players and understand what is happening during fast fights. For competitive players, this means less unnecessary visual obstruction without changing Minecraft's underlying combat mechanics. Lightweight Minecraft Utility Particles Disabler focuses on removing or controlling effects rather than introducing heavy new textures or graphical systems. It is designed as a straightforward Minecraft Bedrock resource pack for players who want: Cleaner PvP Reduced particle clutter Better visibility Low-end device optimization Simplified visual effects Configurable performance modes Minecraft Bedrock and MCPE support Standalone Resource Pack Particles Disabler is a standalone pack . It does not require YashGameplay's Main UI or another base UI pack to function. Activate the resource pack and choose the preferred mode from its available pack settings. Made for Minecraft Bedrock & MCPE Particles Disabler is suitable for players looking for a Minecraft particle remover, MCPE FPS boost pack, PvP particle disabler, Totem particle remover, no potion particles pack, Minecraft Bedrock optimization pack, low-end device resource pack, explosion particle remover, or Minecraft lag reduction texture pack . These terms directly represent the purpose of the pack: controlling distracting particles, improving visibility, and offering multiple configurations for combat, mining, and performance-focused gameplay. Choose How Much You Want to Remove Particles Disabler gives you control instead of removing every effect in every situation. Use PvP Mode when combat visibility matters most. Use Mining Mode for a cleaner underground experience. Use All Off Mode when maximum particle reduction is your priority. With three configurable modes and targeted removal of Totem, potion, explosion, eating, combat, fire, smoke, and other particle effects, Particles Disabler provides a cleaner and more performance-focused Minecraft Bedrock experience.

title: Clear Transparent Inventory
description: Read redstone signal strength with a brush and choose between vanilla and clean dust textures.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Clear Transparent Inventory makes the inventory interface in Minecraft Bedrock fully clean and transparent, and also provides a simple way to add your own background images. Important note: By default this pack is shipped completely empty (no pre-installed wallpapers). When installed as-is, the inventory background becomes fully transparent. The built-in subpacks (dark, light, minimalist) are ready-made templates — just insert your own .png images into them and switch between them in-game at any time. What it does: - Fully transparent background — removes the solid black/gray rectangle behind the player model and inventory window so you can clearly see the world around you. - Clean interface and slots — makes the inventory panel and hotbar slots semi-transparent and less cluttered for better visibility. Perfect for: - PvP and BedWars players who need full situational awareness while managing inventory. - Players who prefer a clean, minimalist interface without the heavy default gray background. - Anyone who wants custom inventory wallpapers without creating UI JSON files from scratch. If you only want a transparent inventory You don't have to read further — just install the pack and you're done. --- Step 1: Unpack and replace the background image 1. Rename the .mcpack file to .zip and unpack it into a separate folder. 2. Go into one of the subpack folders, for example: subpacks/dark/textures/ui/ (or light / minimal) 3. Replace the file dialog_background_opaque.png with your own image. Important: The image must be in .png format and keep the exact same filename: dialog_background_opaque.png 4. (Optional) You can also edit dialog_background_opaque.json. This file controls how the image is stretched and scaled. If your image has a specific resolution (for example 1280×1088), open the .json file and update the "base_size" values: "base_size": [1280, 1088] Note: Do not replace files in the root textures/ui/ folder. Always work only inside the subpack folders to keep the pack stable. --- Step 2: Rename or add new subpacks (optional) How to rename a subpack (example: dark → scare): 1. Rename the folder: subpacks/dark → subpacks/scare 2. Open manifest.json and find the corresponding entry: { "folder_name": "dark", "name": "Dark" } 3. Change both values to the new name: { "folder_name": "scare", "name": "scare" } 4. Save the file. How to add a new subpack: 1. Create a new folder inside subpacks, for example: subpacks/my_bg 2. Copy the entire textures folder from an existing subpack (e.g. subpacks/dark) into the new folder. 3. Go to subpacks/my_bg/textures/ui/ and replace dialog_background_opaque.png with your image. 4. Open manifest.json and add a new entry to the "subpacks" array: { "folder_name": "my_bg", "name": "my_bg" } 5. Save the file. --- Important note about UUIDs If you customized the pack (replaced dialog_background_opaque.png) and already have the original version installed, it is strongly recommended to change one digit in each of the two UUID values in manifest.json. This prevents Minecraft from treating your customized pack as a duplicate of the original. If you have never installed the original pack, you can skip this step. --- Step 3: Pack and install 1. Go back to the root folder of the pack (you should see the textures and subpacks folders + manifest.json and pack_icon.png). 2. Select all these items together (do not select the outer parent folder) and compress them into a .zip archive. 3. Rename the .zip file back to .mcpack. 4. Open the .mcpack file to import it into Minecraft. 5. Go to Settings → Global Resources (or the resource packs of your world). 6. Find the pack and open its settings (the three-line icon or settings button next to it). In the subpack selection window, switch the slider to choose the subpack that contains your custom image After that the new background will be applied. You can switch between subpacks at any time through the same gear menu without reinstalling the pack.

compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: BetterHitSounds for Bedrock Make every hit feel satisfying. BetterHitSounds replaces the default attack sounds in Minecraft Bedrock Edition with a punchy custom hit sound, with no mods or add-ons needed. Features Custom hit sound whenever you land a hit Slight random pitch on every hit, so it never sounds repetitive Critical hits get their own louder, higher-pitched version Missed swings keep the vanilla sound, so only real hits play it Lightweight resource pack that only changes what you hear How to install Open the .mcpack file to import it into Minecraft. Go to Settings → Global Resources and activate BetterHitSounds. Fully close and reopen the game. New sounds need a full restart to load. Notes The separate critical hit sound needs Minecraft Bedrock 1.21.130 or newer. On older versions, crits use the normal hit sound. If you hear no change, check that the pack isn't below another pack that changes sounds, and that your Players volume slider isn't at zero. Credits and original project This pack is a Bedrock port of the Fabric mod BetterHitSounds, licensed CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://github.com/hardik-verma/BetterHitSounds The hit sound comes from the original mod. Developed by super ores developer, aka Rouver Cabriana. How this project differs from the original The original is a Java Edition Fabric mod with a config screen, a combo pitch ramp, crit boost and distance falloff. This is a Bedrock Edition resource pack, so it needs no mod and no code. It only replaces Bedrock's own attack sounds, with random pitch variation and a louder, higher-pitched sound on crits. It has no settings screen, no combo system and no distance scaling, because resource packs can't do those.

title: Dawn light

fullDescription: # Dawnlight - Soft Nature Graphics Make Minecraft Bedrock look softer and more natural, with NO shader and NO Vibrant Visuals needed. Dawnlight works on phones, tablets, consoles and PC. ## What it changes - Soft atmosphere: gentle blue haze in the distance instead of a hard fog edge. Every biome has its own tint, from warm sand in deserts to green mist in swamps and jungles, pink haze in cherry groves and cool white in snowy places. - Clear, colorful water: each biome has its own water color, from deep ocean blue to murky swamp green. - Richer plants: more natural greens for grass, leaves and trees that change with the biome. - Sky: a warm sun with soft rays, a detailed moon with craters in all 8 phases, and fluffy clouds. - Soft weather: thin, light rain and round, fluffy snowflakes. - New block textures at 32x32: stone, dirt, grass, sand, gravel, cobblestone, mossy cobblestone, stone bricks, bricks, all wood types (planks, logs and log tops), leaves, snow, glass, obsidian, netherrack, end stone, bedrock and all the ores. ## Four looks to choose from Open the pack in Global Resources, tap the gear icon and pick a look: - Clear Sky: no haze, so you can see far - Misty Morning: thick, cinematic fog - Golden Hour: warm, golden-toned light and plants - Autumn: orange and red leaves and yellow grass If you pick nothing, you get the normal Dawnlight look. ## How to install 1. Download and open the .mcpack file. Minecraft will import it. 2. Go to Settings, then Global Resources, and activate Dawnlight. 3. Optional: tap the gear icon to pick a look. ## Good to know - This is a texture pack, not a shader, so it cannot add real shadows, reflections or light rays. It improves colors, sky, water, weather and blocks. - Blocks that are not redrawn keep their normal look, so some blocks may look sharper than others. - Works best with Fancy graphics on. Some of the effects may look different on very old versions of Minecraft. ## Feedback Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment. I read them all and use your ideas for updates. By Kreative Blocks

compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: This texture pack reverts most of the Minecraft textures to their earliest versions based on all of the information of these textures on the internet. Changes: Most of the textures were changed to their earliest versions from the texture atlases or from older versions of the default resource pack. The earliest versions of some textures were found on the internet, recreated based on information available on the internet, or taken from other sources. The grass, leaves, and other foliage have been changed to be the same neon green color all biomes because the old grass and leaves textures were the save neon green color in all biomes. The water has been changed to be the same deep blue color in all biomes because the old water texture was the same deep blue color in all biomes. Credits: Most of the textures that were introduced in later versions of Minecraft before the Village and Pillage update were taken from an earlier version of the Minecraft Bedrock Vanilla Resource Pack. ( https://github.com/ZtechNetwork/MCBVanillaResourcePack/releases/tag/v1.9.0.5 ) The textures that never appeared in any build of Minecraft Java or Minecraft Bedrock came from the History of Textures page on the Minecraft Wiki ( https://minecraft.wiki/w/History_of_textures ) The early candle textures were also taken from the Minecraft Wiki ( https://minecraft.wiki/w/Candle ) The older textures were taken from the Minecraft Texture Atlases which were shown in the Minecraft Wiki ( https://minecraft.wiki/w/Texture_atlas ) Some of the prototype item textures were recreated based on invisible colored pixels in some of the programmer art item textures, and this information came from the Minecraft Wiki. The recreations of the prototype dye textures and prototype iron golem textures were taken directly from the Minecraft Wiki. ( https://minecraft.wiki/w/Unused_textures/Hidden_in_transparency ) The glass texture was taken from a Reddit post which was posted by u/Adam_Hero1 in the r/GoldenAgeMinecraft subreddit. ( https://www.reddit.com/r/GoldenAgeMinecraft/comments/1t9gzat/i_have_recreated_the_classic_glass_texture_from/ ) The stone bricks texture was recreated based on the information from a video posted by _jspecter which explains which textures were used to make most of the other programmer art textures and how the textures were edited to create the derivative textures. At 5:15 in the video, _jspector explains that the fact that the grain in the stone bricks texture is misaligned indicates that the texture was adjusted after the original stone bricks texture was created and shows what the original stone bricks texture would have looked like. ( https://youtu.be/P6BvcLnESIM ) The sand texture is an edited version of one of the sand textures that was shown in _jspecter's video. ( https://youtu.be/P6BvcLnESIM ) The textures that did not have earlier versions were taken from the latest version of the Vanilla Resource Pack ( https://github.com/Mojang/bedrock-samples/releases/tag/v1.26.50.4 )

Added No Particle / Default Subpacks Added Netherite Crown Added Borders for Gravel & Sand -- HazzMCx Tweaks - v1.0.0 The first version still relied heavily on selected textures from the original Bedrock Tweaks collection. These were retained as the foundation while the project began developing its own identity. UI Title PNG Blocky Font Smaller Crosshair Clear Spyglass Scope Splash Texts / Tags Armor Golden Crown New Elytra Model Blocks Borderless Glass -- The Beginning HazzMCx Tweaks originated from BedrockTweaks.net , a website that allows Minecraft Bedrock players to create their own Resource Packs by selecting from a variety of available textures and tweaks. This became the foundation of what would eventually become HazzMCx Tweaks . What started as a collection of selected Bedrock Tweaks gradually became an experiment to develop a Resource Pack with its own identity. -- The Old Generation Before HazzMCx Tweaks Rebuilt , the project had already been published publicly. The old project was uploaded with an early version of the pack and was downloaded by 51 people . At the time, the project was still in an experimental stage. The release was essentially an early, raw version of the project rather than the more organized version history that exists today. The old release became an important part of the project's history. It showed that HazzMCx Tweaks had already reached other players, while also revealing the need for a cleaner structure, clearer versioning, and a more mature development process. Those 51 downloads are not being erased from the story. They are part of where HazzMCx Tweaks came from. -- HazzMCx Tweaks Rebuilt This project represents a new generation derived from the original project . Rather than continuing the old project with its inconsistent history, the pack is being rebuilt from its foundation with a cleaner structure and a more consistent versioning system. The new generation starts again from v1.0.0 , allowing each version to be properly documented and developed in sequence. The purpose of Rebuilt is not to pretend the old project never existed. It is to take what was created before, preserve its roots, and build it again into something more refined and mature. The old project was the experiment. Rebuilt is the continuation of what that experiment became. -- Once an experiment. Now refined

title: Immediately Clean

compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: This is an FPS Boost pack focused on removing particles , fog , and unnecessary animations . It works on all devices and can help reduce lag for a smoother gameplay experience. For the best performance, I recommend using it together with Lithium Reversed and Sodium GL to get even higher FPS. What Does This Pack Remove ? This pack removes unnecessary animations and effects such as campfire smoke, fire, stonecutter animations, underwater bubbles, Nether particles, and more. Don't worry. No player or mob animations have been removed. This pack does not replace any textures, so it should not cause conflicts with other texture packs. You can safely use it with Bare Bones and other texture packs. Only two textures, water and lava, have been optimized. Fast Better Grass This pack also includes Fast Better Grass to optimize the rendering of the ground. I did not create Fast Better Grass myself, but I decided to use it because of its quality and accuracy. It works well with different texture packs and keeps the ground rendering optimized. Thanks to the original creator of Fast Better Grass . Key Features Fog : More than 102 fog effects have been removed or optimized, including Nether fog, underwater fog, lava fog, rain fog, and other environmental fog effects. Particles : More than 199 particles have been removed from the game, which is more than most FPS Boost packs. All particle amounts are set to 0, so you don't have to worry about any particles remaining. Animations : More than 40 unnecessary animations have been removed, including lava, water, fire, campfire, Warden Sonic Boom, rain, and more. Why Remove These Effects? Particles : Heavy particle effects, such as explosions, can cause performance issues on weaker devices. Large amounts of particles may even cause crashes in some situations. By removing them, situations such as fighting the Wither can become much smoother and more optimized. Fog : Removing annoying fog effects, such as Nether fog, underwater fog, lava fog, rain, and storms, can make the game clearer and more enjoyable to play. Animations : Some animations and effects, such as Nether particles and campfire smoke, can contribute to lag. Removing them makes the game cleaner, lighter, and smoother. Credits Made by Grave Herald . I hope you can enjoy Minecraft with less lag .

fullDescription: AxyBoost — Performance Resource Pack Maximum Performance. Smooth Gameplay. Vanilla Quality. AxyBoost is a performance-focused Minecraft Java Edition resource pack designed to help create a smoother, more stable, and responsive gameplay experience on low-end PCs, potato computers, and Android devices running Java Edition through compatible launchers. Built around the philosophy of optimizing without ruining the visuals, AxyBoost aims to preserve Minecraft’s recognizable vanilla appearance while reducing unnecessary visual overhead through carefully selected asset optimizations. The goal is to balance maximum practical FPS, visual clarity, and a clean, attractive Minecraft experience without making textures blurry or sacrificing quality unnecessarily. Key Goals and Features - FPS-Focused Optimization: Target unnecessary visual overhead and resource-intensive assets where resource-pack changes can provide meaningful benefits. - Sharp Vanilla Visuals: Preserve Minecraft’s original texture style, recognizable blocks, items, and environments. - Low-End Device Friendly: Designed with limited hardware resources in mind, including budget PCs and compatible Android Java Edition setups. - Balanced Performance: Offers a development direction that prioritizes smoother gameplay while preserving visual quality wherever possible. - Reduced Visual Clutter: Aim to simplify selected unnecessary visual effects without removing important gameplay information. - Compatibility-Focused Design: Targets Minecraft Java Edition versions 1.21 through 26.3, with version-specific validation required before claiming full compatibility. - Single-Player and Multiplayer: Intended for client-side use without requiring server installation for ordinary resource-pack features. - No Gameplay Changes: A resource pack focused on visual assets rather than changing Minecraft’s core mechanics. What About CPU, GPU, Memory, and TPS? AxyBoost focuses on the aspects of performance that a resource pack can influence. Texture dimensions, transparency, animations, and other visual assets may affect rendering cost or memory use, depending on the hardware and situation. However, a resource pack cannot directly optimize CPU scheduling, Java memory management, server tick performance (TPS), or network latency. Further improvements in those areas require suitable game settings, performance mods, or server-side optimization. The AxyBoost Philosophy You should not have to make Minecraft look terrible just to make it run better. AxyBoost aims to deliver a cleaner, sharper, and more performance-conscious vanilla experience, with a strong focus on stability, accessibility, and practical optimization. AxyBoost — Boost your performance, not your blur.

title: LIVELY VISUALS

compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: LIVELY VISUALS is an original Bedrock visual-settings resource pack by GURJAR, created for worlds using Vibrant Visuals. Its art direction is cinematic yet readable: preserve the familiar block-built world, then shape its mood with daylight color, atmospheric depth, soft contrast, and clearer moving water. The pack does not replace terrain, add structures, or reproduce any supplied screenshot. Across forests and jungles, the profile balances evergreen shade with a gentle leaf-toned ambient lift. Warm directional light and restrained scattering can reveal shafts through canopy gaps when the camera, weather, and geometry allow. Forest water receives a subtle cool-green character, modest surface motion, and the game’s built-in caustic effect underwater. Cherry groves and flower-rich scenes receive a rose-and-lilac atmosphere. Dawn and sunset shift toward soft pink, while daytime stays bright enough to preserve pale blossoms and block textures. Saturation is raised cautiously so petals stand out without turning foliage neon. Plains, savannas, and village settings lean into honeyed sunlight, warm lantern accents, and readable cool shade. Badlands and desert terrain use copper, terracotta, and burnt-orange tones, with a restrained horizon glow that keeps cliff edges and alcoves visible instead of flattening them into red. Water and underwater spaces are part of the scene rather than a separate filter. The presets favor clean blue, turquoise, or green-blue appearances by biome family, with calmer waves intended to add movement without hiding the block palette. Caustics use Minecraft’s built-in rendering resource; no copied caustic image is included. Underwater fog stays blue and moderately transparent, allowing ruins, plants, and lanterns to remain readable while light shafts appear only where the renderer and scene support them. Cold mountains use crisp blue daylight and cool shadows. Flower gardens can use a softer mist profile, while caves receive conservative ambient lift so contrast remains useful during play. Night settings favor deep blue skies, pale moonlight, and visible silhouettes rather than crushed black. Across the pack, color grading is restrained: highlights retain detail, shadows keep texture, and the block-based visual language remains recognizable. LIVELY VISUALS is a resource-pack configuration, not a replacement graphics engine, universal shader injector, or promise of identical screenshots on every device. Results depend on game build, supported hardware, Vibrant Visuals availability, graphics preset, biome, time, weather, resource-pack order, and the camera’s view of the sun. Activate the pack and select Vibrant Visuals in Video settings. Use the modern package on supported stable versions; the separate 1.21.80 build is an experimental legacy profile for builds where that renderer accepts resource-pack settings. The design began from nine user-provided references, studied for broad qualities such as dawn direction, forest contrast, sunset hue, underwater shafts, mist, and night color. Those images are not included, and no third-party shader code, texture, logo, or screenshot has been copied into this pack. The settings, profile names, icon artwork, short description, and image prompts were created specifically for LIVELY VISUALS. The pack adds atmosphere without changing gameplay, world generation, or player-built structures, so it can be tried in an existing world after making a backup. For publication, identify the creator as GURJAR and the project as LIVELY VISUALS. This is an independent fan-made resource pack, not an official Minecraft product. Before publishing, select a distribution license and upload version that match your plans and CurseForge’s current requirements. Test the exact release file on the game versions and devices you list, and invite users to report issues with their device, game version, graphics mode, and active packs. The goal is a more expressive world that remains unmistakably Minecraft: warm light, cool shade, clear water, richer color, and room for each player’s own creation to shine.

This pack is designed for players who want maximum FPS and zero distractions, whether you're doing PVP, survival, or heavy exploration. 🌟 What It Does Particles Disabled All unnecessary particle effects like: -Smoke -Fire sparks -Hit particles -Dust, animations, and ambient effects are completely removed. This reduces GPU and CPU load, making Minecraft run much smoother without changing the core visuals of the game. Three Subpacks - Pick Your Level Choose your particle removal level directly on the pack. Go to Settings → Resource Packs , tap No Particles FPS , and use the slider to switch between three modes: Lite — Removes 47 heavy particles (weather, block breaking, all 8 falling dust types, campfire smoke, all 6 leaf particle types, flames, lava drips and all 5 portal effects). On top of Lite it also clears bubbles, water splashes, explosions, drips and mob flames. Best for PVP and survival players who need visual cues but want smooth frames. Max FPS — Removes 187 particles and blanks 15 more textures: the particle atlases, the environment sheets and the enchantment glint. Everything except crit, totem and mob-growth feedback is gone. fullDescription: RELAX VISUALS: Calm Skies, Clear Water, Quiet Nights RELAX VISUALS is a lighting and atmosphere pack for Minecraft Bedrock, built for Vibrant Visuals. It keeps the blocks, textures and feel of classic Minecraft and changes only the light around them. The result is relaxed and cinematic: cool teal-blue daytime skies, purple dusks with a glowing pale-gold sun, soft blue haze in the distance, clear turquoise water, and blue moonlit nights that stay bright enough to explore. Every biome gets its own colour of haze and sun rays, so each place has its own mood. What You Get Cool, clear daytime skies. The sky moves from a deep teal-blue at the top to a pale blue-grey haze near the horizon. Distant terrain fades into a soft blue tint, giving landscapes a strong sense of depth. A colour-grading pass boosts contrast and colour so greens, reds and blues stand out. Purple sunsets and sunrises. At dusk and dawn the sky turns deep violet and mauve while the sun glows a pale warm gold. The contrast makes sunsets striking and helps light shafts through trees stand out. Bright blue moonlit nights. Night skies are a soft blue-violet rather than pure black, with cool moonlight and purple-blue shadows. Lanterns, torches, candles and campfires glow warmly against the blue. Clear turquoise water. Water is tuned to be clean and bright, with a gentle tint from the surrounding biome, finer waves, and sharper, animated caustic patterns on the floor of shallow water. The caustics texture was created from scratch for this pack. Biome-coloured sun rays and haze. The pack tints the volumetric fog that carries the light shafts, so rays and haze take on the colour of the biome around you. It covers all 89 biomes with 39 hand-tuned light themes, including caves, oceans and the other dimensions. A few examples: Plains, Savanna and Desert: warm amber haze softened by cool distance tones Birch Forest and Flower Forest: soft peach mist Jungle and Bamboo Jungle: cool grey-green mist with green light shafts Swamp and Mangrove: thick yellow-green fog Taiga: gentle sage-green mist Snowy and Mountain Biomes: cool blue-lavender haze Oceans: aqua and deep blue Warm, coloured local lights. Torches, lanterns, campfires, candles, glowstone, lava and other light sources cast their own coloured light on nearby blocks. Soul torches glow blue, copper torches glow green, and amethyst glows violet. A violet End and a darker Nether. The End has a rich violet sky with a lavender glow. Each Nether biome has its own sky and glow, and Crimson Forest is deep red with a nearly black ceiling. Soft shadows and cinematic colour. Soft-edged shadows and a vivid colour-grading pass add depth without crushing shadows or blowing out highlights. Two Versions RELAX VISUALS: the main pack, with rich haze and colour. RELAX VISUALS (Soft): the same look with lighter haze and gentler rays, for a more natural feel. How to Use It Import the .mcpack file by tapping or double-clicking it. Do not unzip it into a folder. Go to Settings, then Global Resources, and activate RELAX VISUALS. Turn on Vibrant Visuals in Video Settings. For the best rays and dusk colours, explore at sunrise or sunset, among trees, hills and mist. Tips Use only one Vibrant Visuals pack at a time to avoid conflicts. If the effect feels too strong, switch to the Soft version. This pack changes light, colour, sky, haze and water. Block textures and cloud shapes come from the game or from other packs you use. Compatibility Built for Minecraft Bedrock Edition and Pocket Edition, with Vibrant Visuals enabled. Vibrant Visuals pack features require version 1.21.120 or later. Vibrant Visuals does not exist in older versions of the game, so this pack’s lighting effects will not appear there. It needs a device that supports Vibrant Visuals, and performance depends on your hardware and render distance. title: Compatible
description: Compatible Shader recolours Minecraft's Vibrant Visuals light, haze and colour grading for each biome: pink cherry groves, vivid emerald forests, golden ice spikes and teal moonlit nights. One file, original work by GURJAR.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Compatible Shader is a bold colour-and-light add-on for Minecraft Bedrock Edition's Vibrant Visuals graphics mode. It does not replace textures or change gameplay. Instead it repaints the atmosphere: cherry groves glow pink, forests turn deep emerald, deserts blaze amber, snowy lands shine with golden light, and nights wash the world in cool teal moonlight. Each biome gets its own mood, so travelling across your world feels like walking through different paintings. The pack is built from four ideas. First, directional lighting: the sun and moon carry biome-specific colours that reach blocks, leaves, water and sky. Second, coloured volumetric haze: featured biomes receive a tinted fog that catches sunlight and turns it into visible beams between tree trunks, hills and clouds. Third, colour grading: every featured biome has its own saturation, warmth and tint, which makes greens vivid and pinks rich while keeping detail. Fourth, teal night lighting: moonlight shifts toward a glowing aqua-teal, giving lakes, swamps and villages a dreamy midnight look. Water is tuned too: clearer, richer colours, livelier waves and brighter caustic light patterns on the bottom. One single file is all you need. Compatible Shader is made to load on Minecraft Bedrock 1.21.100 and newer, including the 26.x releases, so you do not have to pick between several downloads. Because the pack has to work on every one of those versions, it keeps one steady colour tint through the day instead of changing colour at sunrise and sunset. Featured biomes are Cherry Grove, Forest, Flower Forest, Birch Forest, Old Growth Birch Forest, Plains, Sunflower Plains, Taiga, Old Growth Pine and Spruce Taiga, Snowy Taiga, Snowy Plains, Windswept Hills, Jungle, Bamboo Jungle, Sparse Jungle, Savanna and Desert. Other Overworld biomes keep their familiar look, but their sunlight and moonlight are re-tinted: Ice Spikes receive a warm golden light, Mushroom Fields a soft pearly lilac, Swamps a misty green-teal, and Badlands a coral glow. The Nether and the End are left untouched. Everything in the pack is original. It contains no copied shaders, textures or code. It is made entirely from official Vibrant Visuals data files that Minecraft already supports, namely lighting, fog, colour grading and client biome definitions, and every colour value was chosen by hand for this project. Light intensity follows the current vanilla scale, so exposure stays balanced. fullDescription: JUST FPS BOOST - Ultimate Performance Resource Pack for MCPE / Bedrock (1.20 - 1.21+) Are you experiencing annoying lag, sudden frame drops, or heavy stuttering during intensive PvP fights, survival exploration, or multiplayer servers? Say hello to JUST FPS BOOST! This is the ultimate performance-focused client resource pack designed specifically to optimize Minecraft Pocket Edition (MCPE) and Minecraft Bedrock Edition for low-end to mid-range mobile devices and PCs. Instead of degrading your game's default aesthetic, JUST FPS BOOST targets and removes only the unnecessary, heavy visual clutter and performance-draining animations. By flattening complex textures and disabling intensive rendering processes, this client-side pack significantly reduces CPU and GPU load, squeezing out every single frame possible for a buttery-smooth gameplay experience. ⚡ Key Optimization Features: • No Shield Overlay (Low Shield): Removes the bulky, oversized shield graphic from your active screen view when holding or blocking. Gives you 100% full screen visibility during competitive PvP fights. • All Particles Removed: Heavy particle animations—including TNT explosions, smoke, critical hits, potion swirls, and campfire embers—are completely turned off. No more sudden lag spikes in chaotic situations! • Plain Liquid Textures: The heavy, complex flowing animations for Lava are replaced with a clean, solid, performance-friendly flat texture to reduce rendering overhead instantly. • No Animated Portals (No Flip-Book): Animated textures for both the Nether Portal and End Portal are completely flattened. Removing these looping animations saves massive frames when standing near dimensions. • Zero Weather & No Clouds: Clouds, rain, and snow rendering are completely disabled. Say goodbye to game-breaking lag and stuttering during severe world thunderstorms. • Custom Short Swords: Specially designed low-profile short swords that occupy minimal screen space, allowing for vastly superior peripheral vision and cleaner PvP combo tracking. • No Spyglass Scope: Deletes the restrictive, dark vignette border overlay when zooming with the spyglass, granting you unobstructed visibility across the entire screen. • No Pumpkin Blur: Completely removes the annoying dark silhouette overlay when wearing a carved pumpkin head. Look directly at Endermen safely with 100% crystal-clear sight. 🚀 Why Choose "JUST FPS BOOST"? 1. Maximized Game Performance: Tailored natively for budget mobile devices, tablets, and low-end platforms to provide a massive FPS increase by cutting out demanding rendering cycles. 2. Competitive PvP Advantage: Cleaner screen space, zero obstruction from shields or swords, and zero particle distractions allow you to track your targets and land perfect hits every time. 3. Vanilla-Friendly Style: It keeps the authentic, core look of vanilla Minecraft intact, altering only the components that hurt your device's frames. 📥 Simple Installation Guide: 1. Download the official .mcaddon file from the active download section below. 2. Open your file manager, locate the downloaded file, and tap/click it. Minecraft Bedrock will automatically launch and import the resource pack. 3. Navigate to Minecraft Main Menu -> Settings -> Global Resources. 4. Click on "My Packs", find JUST FPS BOOST, and click "Activate". Ensure it is dragged to the very top of your Active Pack list.

title: BRG Arctic Horizon: Frost & Mist
description: viridusk visual reshapes the look of your world with a lush emerald-green atmosphere, warm golden-hour light, and soft, moody depth. Every sunrise, sunset, and night gets a more atmospheric feel while the game keeps its Minecraft charm.
