fullDescription: YG Dreamy Shader is a hand-tuned Vibrant Visuals configuration for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, built to make every biome feel like it's lit from within. Unlike traditional GLSL shader packs for Java Edition, YG Dreamy Shader runs entirely on Mojang's native Vibrant Visuals (RenderDragon) pipeline — no mods, no heavy external renderer, just a resource pack you drop straight into Minecraft. The heart of this pack is light. Sun rays have been sharpened and intensified so that early morning and late evening light cuts dramatically through forest canopies, bamboo groves, and swamp mist, creating those unmistakable "god ray" moments PC shader fans love. The sky itself has been retuned across the full day-night cycle: sunrise and sunset horizons burn with deeper oranges and pinks, the overhead sky reads richer and more saturated, and moonlit nights carry a cool, believable blue glow. Color grading has been pushed further across shadows, midtones, and highlights, giving the whole world a warmer, more vivid, slightly dreamy look without blowing out detail or crushing shadows — thanks to ACES tone mapping doing the heavy lifting under the hood. Water reflects and catches caustic light more noticeably, glowing blocks like torches, lanterns, glowstone, shroomlight, and portals burn brighter, and volumetric fog has been thickened just enough to make light shafts genuinely visible without fogging up your view distance. The Nether and The End get special attention. Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Basalt Deltas, Soul Sand Valley, and the classic Nether wastes each carry their own boosted, neon-leaning color identity, while the End's purple skies and glowing towers are pushed into full, saturated glow — matching the moody, otherworldly look that inspired this edit. Every biome in the game is covered, from oceans and mesas to cherry groves and the pale garden, each with its own fine-tuned atmosphere, fog, and color grading file, so the pack behaves consistently no matter where you explore. It ships with two cloud options — vanilla clouds for lower-end devices, and a custom 32x cloud subpack for a softer, more painterly sky on stronger hardware. YG Dreamy Shader is best experienced on devices that support Vibrant Visuals (Minecraft 1.21.120+, with PBR/RenderDragon graphics enabled). It's built for players who want their Bedrock world to feel cinematic — warm sunsets, glowing biomes, and rays of light you can actually see — without installing a single shader mod. fullDescription: Step into a world reimagined. YG Fantasy Shader is a vibrant, glow-forward visual overhaul for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, built on the RenderDragon Vibrant Visuals lighting engine and crafted to turn every sunrise, sunset, and starlit night into a cinematic fantasy scene. At the heart of this shader is light itself. The sun no longer just rises, it blazes. Enhanced Mie scattering wraps the horizon in bold, sweeping sun rays, while a broadened golden-hour glow bathes the land in warm amber and rose-gold tones before the sky dissolves into deep violet twilight. Rayleigh scattering has been pushed further, giving the sky a richer, more saturated gradient that shifts from soft blue daylight into dramatic magenta and purple sunsets reminiscent of a painted fantasy realm. Beneath that sky, volumetric fog does more than add distance haze, it catches the light. Increased scattering density and tightened forward scattering make crepuscular light shafts punch through forest canopies and cave openings, giving every biome a sense of atmosphere and depth that vanilla lighting simply cannot match. Underground, the world glows back. Every ore, diamond, emerald, gold, redstone, lapis, copper, and their deepslate variants, has had its emissive properties intensified, so veins genuinely shine in caves rather than sitting flat and dull. Combined with subtly boosted PBR emissive fallback values across blocks, items, actors, and particles, the whole world carries a faint, living luminescence, from lanterns and campfires to enchanted structures. Color grading ties it all together with a refined highlights-midtones-shadows pipeline, boosted saturation and gain, and ACES tone mapping for a cinematic, high-dynamic-range look that avoids blown-out whites or muddy shadows. A tuned white balance keeps warm light feeling warm and cool night skies feeling appropriately cool. Despite all these enhancements, YG Fantasy Shader is built to stay performance-friendly. It uses Minecraft Bedrock's native Vibrant Visuals configuration system rather than heavy custom shader code, meaning it runs efficiently on a wide range of devices, including many mobile and console setups, without the frame-rate cost of traditional shader packs. Whether you're exploring a lush jungle at dawn, mining through glowing deepslate caverns, or watching a violet aurora roll over the night sky above your base, YG Fantasy Shader is designed to make every moment in your world feel like a page out of an epic fantasy story. Grab your torch, watch the horizon catch fire at dawn, and see Minecraft Bedrock the way it was always meant to glow. title: Golden Glow Shader
description: A warm, cinematic golden-hour reskin for Vibrant Visuals — glowing low sun, soft amber haze, filmic color grading, and tannin-warm water across 47 biomes, with a rose-gold variant for Cherry Grove.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Golden Glow Shader reskins Minecraft Bedrock's Vibrant Visuals renderer for a warm, cinematic look inspired by golden-hour photography. Instead of a compiled shader binary, it is built entirely from Mojang's official Vibrant Visuals JSON systems: lighting, atmospherics, color grading and water. That keeps it lightweight and transparent, and compatible with every device Vibrant Visuals already runs on, from phones to consoles to PC, with no extra performance cost beyond Vibrant Visuals itself. The sunrise and sunset window is stretched and deepened, with the sun's color sliding through warm gold and amber instead of snapping straight from white to dark. Mie scattering around the sun is boosted for a soft, glowing halo, while the sky blends from a warm cream horizon into a deep dusk zenith overhead. Color grading pushes orange-leaning highlights against slightly cooler shadows for a filmic split-tone, finished with ACES tonemapping, lifted saturation, and a warm 5200K color temperature that ties the whole scene together. Water gets gentle tannin warmth, visible caustics, and softened waves, so lakes, rivers and oceans glow instead of looking flat and blue. Rather than one global override, these settings are applied individually across 47 overworld biomes, so plains, forests, jungles, deserts, oceans, swamps and snowy biomes each get an appropriate variant — swamps run murkier and greener, open water stays clearer and tealer, deserts and savannas lean into the warmth naturally. Cherry Grove breaks from the orange palette entirely for its own rose-and-gold variant, matching its pink blossoms instead of fighting them. Requirements: Minecraft Bedrock 1.26.40 or newer, with the "Vibrant Visuals" experimental toggle switched on in world settings. No other experiments, add-ons, or behavior packs are needed — just enable Vibrant Visuals and apply the pack. Created by GURJAR. Credits Author / Creator: GURJAR Built with: Minecraft Bedrock's official Vibrant Visuals JSON API (lighting, atmospherics, color grading, water, client biomes) — no third-party shader code or compiled binaries included. Engine target: Minecraft Bedrock 1.26.40+ Key Features Extended, deepened golden-hour sun with a soft glowing halo Warm horizon-to-zenith sky gradient Filmic color grading (orange highlights / cool shadows) with ACES tonemapping Tannin-warm, clearer water with visible caustics and softened waves Per-biome tuning across 47 overworld biomes (not one flat global look) Unique rose-gold variant for Cherry Grove Pure JSON — no compiled shader binaries, small download size Requirements Minecraft Bedrock Edition 1.26.40 or newer Vibrant Visuals experimental toggle enabled in world settings No other experiments or add-ons required Installation Download and open `GoldenGlowShader_by_GURJAR_v0.1.1.mcpack` — Minecraft will import it automatically. Create or edit a world → Settings → Experiments → enable Vibrant Visuals. Go to Resource Packs, find Golden Glow Shader under My Packs, and activate it. Play — the effect is visible immediately, strongest around in-game sunrise/sunset.

Song Naming Format Each song must use its corresponding number: Song 1 → 1.ogg Song 2 → 2.ogg Song 3 → 3.ogg Song 4 → 4.ogg Song 5 → 5.ogg Continue the same numbering system for the rest of your songs, up to Song 100. My Music Player is a resource pack for Minecraft Bedrock Edition that adds a simple in-game music player. Unlike normal music packs, this pack does not include any songs. This keeps the download small and avoids copyright issues. Instead, you can add your own music to the pack. Features: In-game music player menu Supports multiple custom songs Works in Minecraft Bedrock Edition Lightweight resource pack *No Copyrighed Music Included How to add your own music: Download and install the resource pack. Open the pack's music folder (MyMusicPlayer/sounds/music/). Convert your music to .OGG format. Copy the files into the music folder. Rename them like this: song_1.ogg song_2.ogg song_3.ogg song_4.ogg ... Enable the resource pack and open the in-game Music Player menu. Press the button for the song you want to play. *Important No music is included with this pack. You must provide your own audio files. Only use music that you own or have permission to use. Songs must be in .OGG format and follow the correct file names (song_1, song_2, song_3, etc.), otherwise they won't play. Enjoy your favorite music while exploring your Minecraft worlds! 🎶 FAQs Q: Why isn't there a Stop Music button? A: A true Stop Music button isn't currently possible using only a Minecraft Bedrock resource pack. While an addon could provide more control, it would reduce compatibility with servers and Realms, make installation more complex, and may cause issues if removed from a world. My Music Player is designed to work as a standalone resource pack with maximum compatibility. Q: Can other players hear the music I play? A: No. My Music Player is a client-side resource pack, so the music only plays for you. Other players in your world or server cannot hear it.

Nether Atmosphere — Nether biomes receive dramatic colored fog: red for Nether Wastes, purple for Soul Sand Valley, crimson for Crimson Forest. Dual Fog System — Base fog plus custom merged fog overlay per biome for smooth transitions. Each biome's fog inheritance is disabled for clean, precise control. Pack Size — ~5.4 MB (includes 80+ individual fog JSON files).

title: The Forgotten Winter
description: The Forgotten Winter transforms Minecraft into a frozen world of the past. Lush greenery becomes snow-covered, frosted foliage, icy plants and wintry landscapes, while subtle mob and environmental changes bring an Ice Age atmosphere to the Overworld.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: The Forgotten Winter transforms Minecraft into a frozen world of the past. Lush greenery becomes snow-covered, frosted foliage, icy plants, and wintry landscapes, while subtle mob and environmental changes bring an Ice Age atmosphere to the Overworld. The pack goes far beyond simple texture changes, introducing custom models, particles, sounds, fog, colormaps, and environmental effects throughout the world. Animals and hostile mobs take on cold-weather appearances, deserts become barren frozen landscapes, and features like ice crystals, falling snow, winter birds, falling branches, and ground ice add life and detail to the environment. At the center of the transformation is a fully remodeled mammoth, replacing the camel while retaining its original animations and rideability. Snowstorms replace rain, snow visually accumulates around the player, and over 80 biomes receive a colder, frostier atmosphere. Despite the scale of the transformation, everything is achieved through a resource pack without changing gameplay or behavior, preserving Minecraft's original mechanics while making the Overworld feel like a world forgotten to time. Screenshots List of Features Features Mob Changes Camel → Mammoth — A fully remodeled mammoth using the camel's animations and remaining rideable. Cold Animals — Chickens, cows, and pigs permanently use their cold-weather variants. Snowy Villagers — Villagers always wear their snow-biome clothing. Frozen Mobs — Creepers, skeletons, spiders, zombies, husks, drowned, and iron golems receive custom snowy/cold textures. Vegetation Snow-Covered Foliage — All leaves (except cherry and birch) , grasses, ferns, vines, firefly bushes, and normal bushes receive handcrafted snowy-white textures. White Vegetation Colormap — All vegetation uses a custom white winter colormap. Dead Birch Trees — Birch leaves are replaced with dark, empty foliage to create the appearance of dead trees. Winter Flowers — Flowers receive darker green stems, with snowy variants for poppies and dandelions. Snowy Crops — Fully grown crops receive custom snow-covered textures. Blocks & Terrain Snowy Grass Blocks — Regular grass blocks are replaced with snow-covered grass blocks. Snow-Covered Crops & Produce — Hay bales, melons, and pumpkins receive new snow-covered textures. Frozen Dripstone — Dripstone is redesigned as 3D ice crystals with a custom model and ice texture. Ground Ice — Thin ice sheets form across the ground during snowfall. Desert Overhaul Cold Grey Sands — Deserts are transformed with pale, cold-grey sand. Scattered Bones — Short dry grass becomes scattered bones with a custom model and texture. Dead Vegetation — Tall dry grass and dead bushes receive varied dark-brown dead vegetation textures. Dead Cacti — Cacti are redesigned with spruce-log textures and custom cactus flowers, while spruce-leaf elements create the appearance of nearly leafless trees. Ground Details Ice Crystals — Leaf litter is replaced by scattered ice crystals in forests. Custom 3D model Multiple varied textures Custom sound New in-game name: Ice Crystals Custom item texture Weather & Atmosphere Snowstorms — Rain is replaced with custom snowstorms and snow particles. Snow Accumulation — Snow visually accumulates on blocks around the player during storms. (Separate from vanilla snow layers and purely visual.) Frosty Fog — Over 80 biomes receive denser, colder-looking fog. Storm Fog — Fog becomes even denser during snowstorms. Ground Ice Formation — Snowfall can visually create thin ice sheets across the terrain. Particles & Ambient Life Cold Breath — New cold-breath particles for the player. Falling Snow — Custom snow particles replace vanilla rain. Falling Leaves — Every leaf type has custom falling-leaf particles with two snowy variants. Falling Birch Branches — Birch particles use custom textures and physics to resemble falling branches. Winter Birds — Four ambient bird particles spawn around trees: black, white, grey, and light brown. 3D Torch Flame — Torches feature a new crossed 3D flame particle.

title: Baku Abandoned City Shader
description: Baku Abandoned City Shader by Baku_Studio – Soft cinematic Vibrant Visuals with warm sunlight, atmospheric haze, muted greens and ...

fullDescription: Baku Abandoned City Shader Author: Baku_Studio Baku Abandoned City Shader is an original Minecraft Bedrock Edition resource pack built for the official Vibrant Visuals (RenderDragon) graphics mode. It is designed to reproduce a soft, cinematic, atmospheric daylight look with natural lighting, gentle fog, muted greens and calm teal water while fully preserving Minecraft’s classic block style and pixel textures. Pack Information Pack Name: Baku Abandoned City Shader Author: Baku_Studio Type: Vibrant Visuals / PBR Resource Pack Supported Versions: Minecraft Bedrock Edition & Pocket Edition 1.21.120 and newer (1.21 – 1.26 generation) Required Graphics Mode: Vibrant Visuals Platform: Android, iOS, Windows, Xbox, PlayStation (devices that support Vibrant Visuals) Installation Import into Minecraft Bedrock. Activate the pack. Set Graphics Mode → Vibrant Visuals . Play. Visual Style The pack focuses on a peaceful, soft, slightly hazy cinematic atmosphere. Lighting is warm-neutral and diffused. Shadows stay soft and never pure black. Distant terrain fades naturally into atmospheric haze. Colors remain muted and natural — especially the greens of grass and leaves. Water appears translucent teal/cyan with soft reflections. The overall mood is calm, immersive and modern while still looking unmistakably like Minecraft. Features Lighting Soft warm-neutral directional sunlight Smooth highlight rolloff (no harsh white clipping) Balanced ambient fill so shadows remain visible Natural contrast between direct sun, ambient light and shade Atmosphere & Fog Soft layered distance fog Atmospheric haze and depth separation Bright horizon glow Mie scattering for gentle sun glow / bloom-like effect Smooth blending of distant terrain into the sky Color Grading Muted cinematic green vegetation Natural medium-to-dark grass and leaf tones Soft shadow lift Controlled highlight compression Subtle warm color temperature (~5800 K) Filmic-style tone mapping Water Translucent teal / cyan-green body color Soft environment and sky reflections Gentle surface waves Soft specular highlights Depth-based coloration Not flat blue and not mirror-like Shadows & Materials Soft natural shadow appearance Subtle ambient occlusion influence through lighting balance Default PBR material response tuned for realistic roughness Preserves original Minecraft block textures and geometry Time of Day Support Keyframed values for sunrise, day, sunset and night Warmer light and stronger haze at sunrise/sunset Cooler ambient tones at night What This Pack Does NOT Do Does not replace Minecraft textures with realistic or AI-upscaled textures Does not change block geometry or proportions Does not require RTX, Java Edition, OptiFine, Iris or any external shader loader Does not use unsupported or invented JSON properties Technical Details Uses only official Vibrant Visuals systems: lighting/global.json atmospherics/atmospherics.json color_grading/color_grading.json water/water.json pbr/global.json Capability: "pbr" Minimum engine version: 1.21.120 Lightweight configuration-only pack (excellent performance) Installation Import the .mcpack file into Minecraft Bedrock. Activate Baku Abandoned City Shader in Global Resources or World Resource Packs. Go to Settings → Video → Graphics Mode and select Vibrant Visuals . Enter any world. Performance The pack is very lightweight because it only adjusts lighting, atmosphere, water and color grading parameters. It runs well on mobile devices that support Vibrant Visuals as well as on Windows and consoles. Credits Created by Baku_Studio . This is an original implementation inspired by cinematic soft-lighting reference visuals. No proprietary shader source code was used or copied.

fullDescription: Clearstone 128x – Faithful Style Clearstone Forged 128x is a high-resolution texture pack for Minecraft Bedrock Edition that keeps the familiar Minecraft appearance while adding sharper details and a refined medieval forged style. Blocks, items, materials, buildings and landscapes have been enhanced with detailed 128x textures. The pack supports both normal Bedrock graphics and Vibrant Visuals in one package. ✦ Main Features High-resolution 128x textures Faithful-style Minecraft appearance Classic Bedrock graphics support Vibrant Visuals support PBR materials Normal maps for selected textures Enhanced stone, wood and metal surfaces Improved tools and item textures Detailed building materials Enhanced villages and medieval structures Improved terrain and landscapes Selected emissive light sources Multiplayer support Bedrock Dedicated Server support One complete hybrid resource pack Classic Graphics & Vibrant Visuals Clearstone Forged 128x combines support for both Minecraft graphics modes in one resource pack. With normal Bedrock graphics enabled, the regular high-resolution textures remain available. On supported devices using Vibrant Visuals, selected materials can additionally use: Surface depth Normal maps Metallic properties Roughness differences Enhanced material definition Improved lighting response Selected emissive textures Vibrant Visuals is optional and is not required to use the normal 128x textures. Installation on Minecraft Bedrock Download the .mcpack file. Open the downloaded file with Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Wait until Minecraft confirms that the resource pack was imported successfully. Open the settings of your world. Select Resource Packs . Open My Packs . Find Faithful Style Bedrock Clearstone Forged 128x – Texture Pack . Select the pack and press Activate . Start or restart the world. If your device supports Vibrant Visuals, it can additionally be enabled in the Minecraft video settings. Updating the Texture Pack The internal pack version is: 2.0.0 The pack uses the same internal UUID when updating this 128x edition. A newer release can therefore replace an older version without requiring a new world. If Minecraft continues to display older textures, remove the previous cached version from the Minecraft storage settings and import the latest .mcpack file again. Bedrock Dedicated Server Installation 1. Rename the File Rename the downloaded file extension: Faithful-Style-Bedrock-Clearstone-Forged-128x-Texture-Pack.mcpack to: Faithful-Style-Bedrock-Clearstone-Forged-128x-Texture-Pack.zip Extract the ZIP archive. 2. Copy the Resource Pack Copy the extracted resource-pack folder into the following server directory: resource_packs/ Example: resource_packs/Clearstone-Forged-128x/ The folder must directly contain: manifest.json pack_icon.png textures LICENSE.txt Do not place another .mcpack or ZIP file inside the resource-pack folder. 3. Assign the Pack to Your World Open your server world directory: worlds/YOUR_WORLD_NAME/ Create or edit: world_resource_packs.json Add the following entry: [ { "pack_id": "c192b227-9f82-4867-b116-881fc7395734", "version": [2, 0, 0] } ] The UUID comes from the header.uuid section of the included manifest.json . Do not use the module UUID. 4. Servers with Existing Resource Packs If world_resource_packs.json already contains other resource packs, do not remove them. Add Clearstone Forged 128x as another entry: [ { "pack_id": "EXISTING-RESOURCE-PACK-UUID", "version": [1, 0, 0] }, { "pack_id": "c192b227-9f82-4867-b116-881fc7395734", "version": [2, 0, 0] } ] Remember to place a comma between the entries. 5. Require the Texture Pack To require connected players to download the server resource pack, open: server.properties Set: texturepack-required=true Use false instead if players should be allowed to join without accepting the resource pack. 6. Restart the Server Completely stop and restart the Bedrock Dedicated Server. During startup, check the server log and confirm that the resource pack was loaded successfully. If the log reports that the configured pack could not be found, check that: The pack is inside resource_packs The folder directly contains manifest.json The UUID matches header.uuid The version is [2, 0, 0] world_resource_packs.json is located inside the correct world folder The correct world is selected through level-name in server.properties Updating a Dedicated Server When installing a newer version: Stop the server. Replace the existing resource-pack folder. Open the new manifest.json . Check the new header.version . Update the version inside world_resource_packs.json if it has changed. Restart the server. Players may need to reconnect so Minecraft can download the updated resource pack. Compatibility Minecraft Bedrock Edition Windows Android iOS Consoles where external resource packs are supported Singleplayer Multiplayer Bedrock Dedicated Server Classic Graphics Vibrant Visuals on supported devices Performance depends on the device. Because this is a 128x texture pack, it requires more memory and graphics performance than a normal 16x or 64x resource pack.

fullDescription: This is NOT an RTX pack. RTX Visuals is a Minecraft Bedrock Vibrant Visuals resource pack. It uses Vibrant Visuals features to create RTX-inspired lighting and visuals. RTX Visuals is a project I’ve been working on to make Minecraft feel more alive without completely changing the vanilla style. 72 animated texture sets with 2,600+ animation frames, covering leaves, flowers, grass, vines, crops, bushes, bamboo, saplings, and other vegetation. The main thing I wanted was for the plants to actually feel like they’re moving in the wind instead of just jumping between a few frames. I’ve spent a lot of time experimenting with the animation frames and trying to make the pixels move together with the plant. RTX-inspired lighting Light sources such as torches, lanterns, soul torches, and other glowing blocks have enhanced lighting and Vibrant Visuals support. Soul lights keep their blue/cyan atmosphere, while other light sources keep their own colors. Calm water Water has subtle movement while avoiding distracting bright white spots. The goal is a cleaner, calmer water surface that still feels alive. Vibrant Visuals + volumetric effects The pack takes advantage of Minecraft Bedrock’s Vibrant Visuals features to push the lighting and atmosphere further while keeping the overall look of the pack intact. Credits & Inspiration A huge thank you to Vanilla RTX and the Poppy’s Luminous Dreams shader team . Their projects were a huge inspiration for me, and studying their work and coding helped me learn a lot about how visual effects can be created. Also, a huge thank you to VottexLab and their Better Waving Leaves project on CurseForge for allowing me to use their plant assets as a starting point for creating my own moving-leaf animations. This project wouldn’t have been possible without the inspiration and work from these creators. Please check out and support their original projects! RTX Visuals V2.3.0 — Update Log New in V2.3.0 Added PBR support for improved material detail and surface depth. Improved lighting for a more realistic and cinematic look. Added and improved cinematic fog effects. Improved water visuals and reflections. Enhanced shadows and ambient lighting. Improved particles and visual effects. Updated visual assets for better consistency across the pack. Improved overall color, atmosphere, and environment quality. Optimized visual settings for a smoother experience where possible. Updated the pack name and version to RTX Visuals V2.3.0. Overall RTX Visuals V2.3.0 focuses on making Minecraft Bedrock look more realistic and cinematic through improved PBR materials, lighting, fog, water, shadows, and environmental effects.

fullDescription: ✨ Invisible Buttons – Minecraft Bedrock Addon 📖 About This Addon Invisible Buttons is a Minecraft Bedrock addon designed to give players a cleaner, more minimalistic touch-control interface without removing the functionality of the buttons. This addon makes all on-screen touch-control buttons invisible while keeping them fully functional. This means players can still interact with Minecraft normally, even though the buttons are no longer visible on the screen. The goal is to provide a less cluttered screen, allowing players to enjoy their Minecraft worlds with a cleaner visual experience. 🎮 Features Invisible Touch Controls: All touch-control buttons become invisible, giving the screen a cleaner appearance. Fully Functional Buttons: Even though the buttons cannot be seen, they can still be tapped and used normally. Copy Button Remains Visible: The Copy button is intentionally kept visible and is not affected by the addon. Cleaner Gameplay: Removing visible buttons reduces interface clutter and gives players more unobstructed screen space. Mobile-Friendly Experience: Designed for Minecraft Bedrock players who use touchscreen controls on mobile devices and tablets. 🌟 How Does It Change Minecraft? Normally, Minecraft Bedrock displays several touch-control buttons on the screen while playing. These buttons can cover parts of the game world and sometimes make the interface look crowded. With Invisible Buttons enabled, the touch controls become transparent while retaining their functionality. Players can continue moving and interacting using the same touch-control areas without seeing the buttons. For example, players can explore, build, and play in their worlds while enjoying a cleaner screen. The Copy button remains visible for convenience. 💗 Who Is This Addon For? This addon is useful for: Players who prefer a minimalistic interface. Mobile and tablet players who want less visual clutter. Builders who want a clearer view of their creations. Players who enjoy a cleaner and simpler Minecraft experience. ⚠️ Important Information The touch-control buttons are invisible, not removed. The buttons remain functional and can still be tapped. The Copy button remains visible. This addon changes the appearance of the touch controls, not Minecraft's actual gameplay mechanics. 💖 Enjoy Minecraft with a cleaner screen! Thank you for checking out Invisible Buttons! We hope this addon makes your Minecraft experience more comfortable and enjoyable.

fullDescription: Time to get creative in Minecraft with RTX! Some of the designs were inspired by NVIDIA’s early Minecraft RTX demo texture packs (such as the cool light blocks!) Exotic Education Edition block sets revived from the earliest versions of Vanilla RTX . Known Issues Materials aren't organized and navigating the 119 textures to find what you want may be difficult.
